title: Author Response Latency
scenario: Calculate the average time authors take to comment on their own articles.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, author_id INT), comments (article_id INT, user_id INT, comment_date TIMESTAMP)
hint: Join comments with articles where user_id = author_id.
correctQuery: SELECT author_id, AVG(comment_date - publish_date) FROM articles a JOIN comments c ON a.article_id = c.article_id AND a.author_id = c.user_id GROUP BY author_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, author_id INT); CREATE TABLE comments (article_id INT, user_id INT, comment_date TIMESTAMP);
